Messages.Author: Alan Flesch
Messages.Body:
This may seem to be a strange question...

I have a Renegade Garou with one damage token. My predator has a Brujah
who plays Bum's Rush on the Garou.

Can I block the Bum's rush with the Garou, thus nullifying the Bum's
rush (and more importantly, the optional Maneuver(sp!) that comes with it)?

What I was trying to do was to block the Brujah with the Garou, manuever
to long, and then strike with no damage. On my turn, I'd heal the one
damage and be in better shape to take out a Brujah...

Alan (aj)

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
afl...@charon.usc.edu (Alan Flesch) writes:

>This may seem to be a strange question...

>I have a Renegade Garou with one damage token. My predator has a Brujah
>who plays Bum's Rush on the Garou.

I assume this means that the Garou has two life (Base Hit Points of 3 minus
1 Hit taken).

>Can I block the Bum's rush with the Garou, thus nullifying the Bum's
>rush (and more importantly, the optional Maneuver(sp!) that comes with it)?

Yes. You effectively trade tapping the Garou to nullify the Maneuver from
the Bum's Rush.
